user.title: Set up your Fichero label printer
user.description: The Bluetooth address is optional; leave it blank to scan whenever a session starts. Optionally select an existing SwitchBot entity that presses the printer's power button. Without one, switch the printer on by hand: printing then fails quickly with a clear error when the printer is off, so a script or automation can tell you.
